title: QUIC RFC 9000 Server 0-RTT Transport Parameter Acceptance Policy Verification
verification_method: Focused S7P4P1 requirement-home tests over server 0-RTT transport-parameter acceptance decisions, required and optional remembered-value reductions, non-zero application-data allowance, and restored-value support, plus Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, full Release test suite, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers the internal server policy that decides whether current server transport parameters can support the remembered values needed for 0-RTT acceptance.
expected_result: The focused tests show servers can accept 0-RTT only when current values preserve or exceed remembered required limits, reject each reduced required Section 18.2 limit, reject reduced restored optional values, expose non-zero application-data allowance checks, and reject acceptance when current server parameters are unavailable.
procedure: Run the focused S7P4P1 and CRT early-data guard filter.
Run the full Release test suite without rebuilding.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The client remembered transport-parameter subset is available from the S7P4P1 0068 slice.
Public early-data admission remains closed while internal policy seams are proven.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim public early-data APIs, TLS early_data extension admission wiring, server anti-replay behavior, application-data delivery, or updated-value-in-0-RTT protocol-violation enforcement.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-06. The Release build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, the focused S7P4P1 plus CRT early-data guard filter passed 31/31, regenerated coverage triage marks REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S7P4P1-0005 through REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S7P4P1-0009 trace_clean and reports 1,269 of 1,771 QUIC requirements trace-clean overall, core SpecTrace JSON validation passed for 451 artifacts, the full Release no-build suite passed 4,487/4,487, and git diff --check returned exit code 0 with line-ending warnings only.
